description:
List of all Configuration policies

TIP: Gets a Settings catalog / Endpoint security policy by ID. Pass $expand=settings,assignments to get the configured values (settings[].settingInstance: settingDefinitionId plus choiceSettingValue / simpleSettingValue / groupSettingCollectionValue, nested children) and the target groups in one call. Setting definition IDs are self-describing, e.g. device_vendor_msft_bitlocker_requiredeviceencryption, device_vendor_msft_bitlocker_systemdrivesrequirestartupauthentication. For policies with hundreds of settings, page them with list-configuration-policy-settings instead. Supports $select and $expand.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure

name: get-configuration-policy
